recipe.realism: credible geometry/materials/ports/connections; avoid generic boxes or toy low-poly shapes

functional_color.supply_return: declared legend and arrow directions; blue/orange only for validated circuit roles
functional_color.not_a_fixed_physical_rule: color does not prove actual temperature, voltage or capacity

scene_detail_requirements: 剖口能辨屋面、墙体、梁柱/桁架、楼板和地面支撑层次；适用构件逐项检查。
机柜、设备、管道、阀门、泵、换热面/风扇、散热鳍片与接口具有可辨体积、接点和材质；按图的对象与暴露部位检查。
全景主次清楚，细节不靠发光或颜色块替代；局部放大对应主对象。
建筑材料、场景、载体与设备构型按对象和技术依据选择；参考的砖厂房/燃料供能不是所有园区的固定配置。
管线/电缆各自核对作用与连接；参考箭头、颜色、数量与形式不是事实证据。

acceptance: 逐项人工对照现行规范；机器校验不代替内容与视觉验收

variants.structure: R1-R3：干净暖白、细线、真实材质、拆解与装配
variants.explainer: R4：白底结构叙事、标题/编号/注释独立文字层
variants.cutaway: R5–R14：可信建筑/园区剖面、真实设备、局部放大及核对后的链路；暖白页边/独立说明，具体参考按对象用途选择。
variants.plan: 正交俯视，继承纸面/轮廓/真实构件与功能线，不强加透视

interactive_recipe.lighting: neutral procedural studio, shared soft lights
interactive_recipe.outline: owned EdgesGeometry,35 degrees, nominal WebGL 1px; no picking/bounds ownership
interactive_recipe.export: current view PNG embedded in editable SVG; reuse live label placement and pixel-ratio sizing; actual viewport pixels; not static master or CAD
interactive_recipe.scope: TA-02 shared implementation only; individual geometry/detail migration remains pending
interactive_recipe.public_startup: protected product registry optional for diagnostics; unread is unknown, public geometry stays available

visible_entrypoints.ssd: 2D detail immediately after the SSD-containing system/scale row; BOM-derived storage context and deep-link positioning; real thumbnail in both arrangements; original dossiers/3D inspector retained
visible_entrypoints.scope: TA01–21 actual public completed; TA16system61/TA17scale complete; TA22–23 explicit domain source review, public pending
visible_entrypoints.facility: 2D shell, rack-frame, fire and security each use their own real preview; full cutaway/exploded drawing at its system/scale row; no generic block for completed illustration
visible_entrypoints.domains: facility-atlas.html actual TA21; power-atlas.html/thermal-atlas.html source-reviewed explicit domain artwork, no default category rebinding
